label: Ammonium
definition: Biweekly mean concentration of ammonium in PM2.5 over the residential buffer (ACAG V5.NA.05, ug/m3). (Result column: nh4.)

label: Ammonium — biomass burning
definition: Share of ammonium in PM2.5 attributed to biomass burning (ACAG FromBiomass surface, ug/m3). (Result column: nh4_bm.)

label: Ammonium — non-biomass
definition: Non-biomass ammonium in PM2.5: the plain estimate minus its biomass-burning share (derived, ug/m3). (Result column: nh4_nbm.)
